subject: test(ssh_dotnet): key-auth matrix with runtime-generated keys (Phase 8)
body:
test(ssh_dotnet): key-auth matrix with runtime-generated keys (Phase 8)

Add TestKeyFactory (BouncyCastle) that generates throwaway RSA keys (encrypted +
unencrypted) at test time -- no key material committed. 8 fake-free tests cover the
auth matrix: keys load through SSH.NET, CreatePrivateKeyAuth loads unencrypted +
passphrase-protected keys, throws on wrong/missing passphrase, and
GetAuthenticationMethods adds key auth first (then password) when both are configured.

Integration auth against a live SSH server remains an opt-in / manual step.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

triage.rationale: Tests for SshAuthenticationProvider/SshDotNet classes that do not exist in our fork; would also add BouncyCastle test dependency.
